title: Can Tho in a day
pace: Dawn market, then the old house
summary: Leave Ninh Kiều at dawn for Cái Răng, eat hủ tiếu on the water, walk the Dương house once the listing hours begin, and come back to the quay in the evening.

stops.name: Cai Rang
stops.note: Spend about 60 minutes among the wholesale boats, leaving the quay around 5:00.

stops.name: Hu tieu
stops.note: Order the breakfast bowl from a noodle boat at the market.

stops.name: Binh Thuy house
stops.note: Walk the 1870 house at 144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa between 08:00 and 16:00.

stops.name: Ninh Kieu wharf
stops.note: Spend about two hours on the quay and the night market after dark.

seoTitle: Can Tho in a day — Cai Rang, then the quay
seoDescription: One day from Ninh Kiều: about 60 minutes at Cái Răng, hủ tiếu on the water, the Dương house, and about two hours on the quay in the evening.
